evidence.text: A retry after an ambiguous submission timeout must not create a second exchange order.
src/orders/submit_order.py::submit_order retries once with the same client_order_id after a timeout.

tests/orders/test_submit_order.py::test_timeout_before_acceptance uses FakeExchange.submit_order and asserts FakeExchange.created_order_ids. It covers a timeout before acceptance but not timeout after exchange acceptance; the same fake can accept the first request, raise the caller-visible timeout, and expose the created-order count after retry.
